name: io.github.SHREESHMAN/lineupify
description: Spotify playlists from a festival lineup, a genre, a song, a playlist or a blend. Own client ID.

environmentVariables.name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your own Spotify app (developer.spotify.com/dashboard, redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback). Optional if saved with `lineupify-mcp setup`.

environmentVariables.name: LASTFM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Last.fm API key for tag, similar-artist, similar-song and per-country data.
